name: InstaPods
description:
Getting a small app online normally means renting a server, installing a runtime, configuring nginx, setting up SSL, a firewall and a process manager, then pointing a domain at it. InstaPods skips all of that. Pick a runtime, get a real Linux server with a live HTTPS URL in seconds, from $3 a month flat with no surprise bills.

This connector puts that in the chat window. You can see every pod on your account and whether it is running, deploy a new one from a preset (static, PHP, Node.js or Python), read the logs and files when a site starts failing, fix the file and reload the app, run a shell command inside your own pod, and move a pod up or down a plan when it needs more or less CPU, memory and disk. So "why is my site returning 502" and "put it back up" become the same conversation instead of a detour into a terminal.

Thirteen tools: eight read-only ones for listing pods, presets, plans and regions and for reading files and logs, and five write ones for creating a pod, managing its lifecycle, changing its plan, writing a file and running a command. Read-only tools are annotated as such so they run without a confirmation prompt; every write tool that modifies or removes something prompts you first.

Every action is scoped to the team that owns the OAuth session, so you only ever see and change your own pods. Plan selection and payment happen on instapods.com, never in chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add InstaPods to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add InstaPods to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.instapods.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the InstaPods MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: InstaPods lists 13 MCP tools, including change_plan, create_pod, exec_command, get_logs, get_pod, list_files, list_plans, list_pods, list_presets, list_regions, manage_pod, and read_file.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to InstaPods?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to InstaPods in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
InstaPods requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
InstaPods is developed by InstaPods. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
